newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER-BESIKTAS WANT BARCELONA COACH ROBSON - SPANISH PRESS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-BESIKTAS WANT BARCELONA COACH ROBSON - SPANISH PRESS.

text.p: Turkish club Besiktas have made an offer worth 600 million pesetas ($4.14 million) over two seasons to Barcelona coach Bobby Robson, according to an article in the Spanish sports daily Marca on Thursday.
Robson has a year left on his contract at Barcelona, although few commentators expect him to see it out as first-team coach.
There is speculation that the former England manager may stay on at the Spanish side in a different role.
